import java.util.*;

public class Main {
    static final int MAX_SIZE = (1 << 19) + 5;
    static int N, K, MOD, MAX_VAL;
    static int[] POPCNT = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[] F = new int[MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] A = new int[20][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] B = new int[20][MAX_SIZE];
    static int[][] C = new int[20][MAX_SIZE];
    static long MOD_SQUARED;
    static long[][] TEMP = new long[20][MAX_SIZE];
    static long[] FACTORIALS = new long[MAX_SIZE];
    static long[] INVERSE_FACTORS = new long[MAX_SIZE];

    static long modularExponentiation(long base, long exponent) {
        long result = 1;
        base %= MOD;
        while (exponent > 0) {
            if ((exponent & 1) == 1) {
                result = (result * base) % MOD;
            }
            base = (base * base) % MOD;
            exponent >>= 1;
        }
        return result;
    }

    static void initializeFactorials() {
        FACTORIALS[0] = 1;
        for (int i = 1; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i) {
            FACTORIALS[i] = FACTORIALS[i-1] * i % MOD;
        }
        INVERSE_FACTORS[MAX_VAL] = modularExponentiation(FACTORIALS[MAX_VAL], MOD - 2);
        for (int i = MAX_VAL - 1; i >= 0; --i) {
            INVERSE_FACTORS[i] = INVERSE_FACTORS[i+1] * (i+1) % MOD;
        }
    }

    static int smallestPowerOfTwo(int x) {
        int p = 1;
        while (p < x) p <<= 1;
        return p;
    }

    static void walshTransform(int[] array, int size, boolean isInverse) {
        long[] tempBuffer = new long[MAX_SIZE];
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            tempBuffer[i] = array[i];
        }
        
        if (isInverse) {
            for (int segment = 1; segment < size; segment <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < size; i += segment << 1) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < segment; ++j) {
                        tempBuffer[i + segment + j] = (tempBuffer[i + segment + j] - tempBuffer[i + j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        } else {
            for (int segment = 1; segment < size; segment <<= 1) {
                for (int i = 0; i < size; i += segment << 1) {
                    for (int j = 0; j < segment; ++j) {
                        tempBuffer[i + segment + j] = (tempBuffer[i + segment + j] + tempBuffer[i + j]) % MOD;
                    }
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i < size; ++i) {
            array[i] = (int)(tempBuffer[i] % MOD);
            if (array[i] < 0) array[i] += MOD;
        }
    }

    static void adjustMod(long[] value, int index) {
        if (value[index] >= MOD_SQUARED) {
            value[index] -= MOD_SQUARED;
        }
    }

    static void performMultiplication() {
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(A[i], 0);
            Arrays.fill(TEMP[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i) {
            A[POPCNT[i]][i] = F[i];
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            walshTransform(A[i], MAX_VAL + 1, false);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; i + j <= 19; ++j) {
                for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx) {
                    adjustMod(TEMP, i + j);
                    TEMP[i + j][idx] += 1L * A[i][idx] * B[j][idx];
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx) {
                C[i][idx] = (int)(TEMP[i][idx] % MOD);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            walshTransform(C[i], MAX_VAL + 1, true);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i) {
            F[i] = C[POPCNT[i]][i];
        }
    }

    static void performSquaring() {
        int[][] buffer = new int[20][MAX_SIZE];
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(TEMP[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            for (int j = 0; i + j <= 19; ++j) {
                for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx) {
                    adjustMod(TEMP, i + j);
                    TEMP[i + j][idx] += 1L * B[i][idx] * B[j][idx];
                }
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx) {
                buffer[i][idx] = (int)(TEMP[i][idx] % MOD);
            }
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            walshTransform(buffer[i], MAX_VAL + 1, true);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            Arrays.fill(B[i], 0);
        }
        
        for (int idx = 0; idx <= MAX_VAL; ++idx) {
            B[POPCNT[idx]][idx] = buffer[POPCNT[idx]][idx];
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            walshTransform(B[i], MAX_VAL + 1, false);
        }
    }

    public static void main(String[] args) {
        Scanner scanner = new Scanner(System.in);
        N = scanner.nextInt();
        K = scanner.nextInt();
        MOD = scanner.nextInt();
        MOD_SQUARED = 1L * MOD * MOD;
        
        if ((N & 1) == 1) {
            System.out.println(modularExponentiation(K, N));
            return;
        }
        
        F[0] = 1;
        MAX_VAL = smallestPowerOfTwo(N + 1) - 1;
        initializeFactorials();
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i) {
            POPCNT[i] = Integer.bitCount(i);
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= MAX_VAL; ++i) {
            B[POPCNT[i]][i] = (int)INVERSE_FACTORS[i];
        }
        
        for (int i = 0; i <= 19; ++i) {
            walshTransform(B[i], MAX_VAL + 1, false);
        }
        
        int originalK = K;
        while (K != 0) {
            if ((K & 1) == 1) {
                performMultiplication();
            }
            K >>= 1;
            if (K != 0) {
                performSquaring();
            }
        }
        
        long finalResult = (modularExponentiation(originalK, N) - FACTORIALS[N] * F[N] % MOD + MOD) % MOD;
        System.out.println(finalResult);
    }
}
